subject: SEO Update — ARLO — 2026-09-03
html:
PageWhat ChangedTarget KeywordCheck It
/services/seo-specialist (fix)Found a real, previously-unflagged bug: this page's WebPage schema pointed its url at the homepage instead of itself, its breadcrumb was only 2 levels (Home/ARLO, both pointing at the homepage), and it had zero FAQPage schema despite showing a live 5-question FAQ block — all 5 of its sibling persona pages (account manager, agency owner, Google Ads specialist, paid social buyer, business owner) already had this fixed. Brought it in line: correct canonical url, a proper 3-level breadcrumb (Home / Services / SEO Specialists), and FAQPage schema built directly from the same 5 Q&As already visible on the page.accuracy/schema fix, not keyword-targetedaskarlo.app/services/seo-specialist
All 6 /services/[slug] persona pages (new field)None of the 6 persona pages had a dateModified freshness signal in their WebPage schema (an item flagged open in the original SXO audit). Added it to all 6.freshness signal — schema completenessaskarlo.app/services/account-manager

Why this instead of another blog post or connector page: the connector matrix (5/5 live Google sources) and comparison hub (5/5 named competitors) are both still fully caught up, and every P1 keyword from the original audit already has a shipped page. SE Ranking (the live keyword-data tool) was unauthenticated this session — a human needs to re-connect it before the next live keyword pull or rank-position check can happen. With fresh-data content blocked, re-read the SXO audit's still-open action items instead and found this schema gap, the same class of correctness bug fixed on the 15 destination pages back on 2026-08-24.

Needs your attention: (1) SE Ranking connector needs re-authorization — it's gating both fresh content targeting and weekly rank-position checks. (2) mailchimp's catalog.ts ETA ("August 2026") has now fully lapsed with zero days of slack — worth confirming ship status; if it flips live, that's the first new connector-matrix page available in 5+ months. meta_ads, hubspot, mailerlite, shopify, and stripe are all also still overdue. (3) Off-page link building is still 0 of 6 directories/registries and GSC sitemap submission is still not done — both need a human with a browser, this sandbox has no outbound HTTP access. (4) Also corrected the record on last month's review: it listed a 'claude mcp server pillar page' as still-needed, but that page actually shipped back on 2026-08-06 — noted in the worklog so it doesn't get re-flagged again.

Next: a follow-up look at whether /services/meta-ads-specialist still 404s (flagged as the single worst-scoring page in the original SXO audit) is queued for next session. Full detail in docs/seo-strategy/worklog.txt (top entry).
